description: Header file defining the NetworkChangeNotifierWin class, which monitors network changes on Windows within the Chromium project. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and member variables related to network change detection, connection type, and cost management.

classes.name: NetworkChangeNotifierWin
classes.description: A Windows-specific implementation of NetworkChangeNotifier that detects network changes, connection type, and cost, using Windows APIs and event watchers.

methods.name: NetworkChangeNotifierWin
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the network change notifier.

methods.name: WatchForAddressChange
methods.description: Starts listening for network address changes, with retries on failure.

methods.name: is_watching
methods.description: Returns whether the notifier is currently watching for changes.

methods.name: set_is_watching
methods.description: Sets the watching state.

methods.name: sequential_failures
methods.description: Returns the number of consecutive failures to watch for address changes.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectionCost
methods.description: Retrieves the current network connection cost.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectionType
methods.description: Retrieves the current network connection type.

methods.name: OnObjectSignaled
methods.description: Callback when a network change event is signaled.

methods.name: RecomputeCurrentConnectionType
methods.description: Static method to determine the current connection type.

methods.name: RecomputeCurrentConnectionTypeOnBlockingSequence
methods.description: Performs connection type recomputation on a blocking sequence.

methods.name: SetCurrentConnectionType
methods.description: Sets the current connection type.

methods.name: NotifyObservers
methods.description: Notifies observers of a change in connection type.

methods.name: NotifyParentOfConnectionTypeChange
methods.description: Forwards connection type change notifications to the parent class.

methods.name: NotifyParentOfConnectionTypeChangeImpl
methods.description: Implementation of forwarding connection type change notifications.

methods.name: WatchForAddressChangeInternal
methods.description: Attempts to start listening for address changes; virtual for testing.

methods.name: InitializeConnectionCost
methods.description: Initializes the connection cost information.

methods.name: UpdateConnectionCostFromCostManager
methods.description: Retrieves connection cost from Windows Cost Manager.

methods.name: ConnectionCostFromNlmCost
methods.description: Converts OS enum to internal enum for connection cost.

methods.name: SetCurrentConnectionCost
methods.description: Sets the cached connection cost.

methods.name: OnCostChanged
methods.description: Callback when connection cost changes.

methods.name: ConnectionCostObserverAdded
methods.description: Handles addition of a connection cost observer.

methods.name: OnConnectionCostObserverAdded
methods.description: Posts task to handle observer addition.
